behavior.name: 0x13001124
behavior.description: A flame projectile spawned by a flamethrower. Its scale increases over time based on forward velocity. Depending on the 'sFlame Type's parameter, it can have a tall hitbox with vertical floor snapping, move upwards instead of using gravity, or use a different scaling formula.

field.name: Flame Type
field.description: Determines scaling, hitbox height, and movement direction.
